brief: 🔥 BEST BET: The 'skills layer' for AI coding agents is breaking out — addyosmani/agent-skills, mattpocock/skills & obra/superpowers all spiking the same week. Build the registry/marketplace for production-grade agent skills (npm moment for agents); window is ~2-4 weeks before GitHub absorbs it.
Orchestration tooling is the #2 wave: stablyai/orca (ADE for parallel agents) + deepseek-harness confirm demand for multi-agent dev environments — IDE-adjacent or CLI-native plays win here.
Codebase intelligence is commercializing: Graphify-Labs/graphify turns repos into queryable knowledge graphs — combine with Tencent/WeKnora-style doc RAG for an enterprise 'codebase brain' SaaS.
Voice + agents going local: open-source voice cloning breakout signals on-device agent interfaces as an underserved niche for privacy-first products.
Timing call: 12 breakouts clustered in one theme = land-grab phase. Ship an MVP on the skills layer this week; second-movers become plugins, not platforms.
